lines.t: (Verse 1)
In the quiet when the world slows down,
I hear a whisper.
Like tiny chimes in the air at night.
Every word feels like a song,
Pulling my heart toward Your light.
Every breath is like a melody,
Each sentence a key played.
(Pre-Chorus)
And when You speak, the noise fades out,
Your voice is all I’m hearing now…
(Chorus)
YahuShua, Your my melody.
My sweet, sweet melody.
Lord, Your all I need.
Your words echo deep in me,
Like a tune that carries me.
My song, my poem, my melody.
Your my melody, my echoing melody.
(Verse 2)
Every promise like a gentle tone,
Turning silence into sound,
Your truth is always found.
Even in the stillest place,
I can feel the rhythm of Your grace,
Like a music box that starts to play,
When Your words begin to stay.
(Pre-Chorus)
And every line You’ve ever spoken,
Fills the empty, heals the broken…
(Chorus)
YahuShua, Your my melody.
My sweet, sweet melody.
Lord, Your all I need.
Your words echo deep in me,
Like a tune that carries me.
My song, my poem, my melody.
Your my melody, my echoing melody.
(Bridge – softer, slightly haunting)
When the night feels long and still,
Your voice remains, it always will.
Like echoes in a hollow hall,
Yet filled with love that covers all.
Every word a steady guide,
A melody I hold inside.
(Final Chorus – gentle, lingering)
YahuShua, Your my melody.
My sweet, sweet melody.
Lord, Your all I need.
Every word You speak to me,
Becomes the tune that carries me.
My song, my poem, my melody.
Your my melody, my echoing melody.
